item.summary: VIALET, a Lithuanian electronic money institution, has partnered with Axiology to use tokenised money market funds for safeguarding client funds and for treasury management, the companies announced on 27 October 2026. Axiology runs a DLT trading and settlement system under the EU's DLT Pilot Regime, supervised by the Bank of Lithuania. A separate arrangement with a liquidity provider is meant to give VIALET access to cash during the day without changing the funds' redemption terms. VIALET says it manages about 150 million euros in assets.
